name: Business Finland – Sprint funding (pilot)
deadline: 2026 pilot call (reported window Mar–Aug 2026); watch for next call
description: Replacement for discontinued Tempo. First R&D funding for small companies (<50 employees, reported) with a new innovation and fast international growth potential; advances possible for companies <5 yrs.
notes: Tempo CLOSED and NIY (Young Innovative Company) closed 10 Oct 2025 — never recommend those.

name: Business Finland – Deep Tech Accelerator
description: For startups <5 yrs founded to commercialise recent research. Reported up to €400k per phase across 3 phases (unverified).

name: Business Finland – Research to Business (R2B)
description: For research organisations commercialising research results (spin-out preparation). Perfect bridge for Lab2Impact participants.

name: Business Finland – Research–SME cooperation call
deadline: To be held again in 2026 (date TBA)
description: Joint projects between research orgs and SMEs.

name: Business Finland – Veturi (leading company ecosystems)
description: Large companies (e.g. Wärtsilä, Meyer Turku historically) build ecosystems; SMEs/startups join as partners with BF funding. Route: become a partner of a Veturi company.

name: Finland's EMFAF Programme 2021–2027 (EMKVR)
provider: Ministry of Agriculture and Forestry / ELY Centres
description: National implementation of the European Maritime, Fisheries and Aquaculture Fund: investment & innovation aid for aquaculture, fisheries, processing.

name: ELY Centre – Business Development Aid
description: Development/investment aid for SMEs (internationalisation, new products, capacity).

name: Water Protection Enhancement Programme (Baltic Sea & inland waters)
description: Funds projects reducing nutrient loads, hazardous substances and restoring Baltic Sea & inland waters.

name: Finnvera – loans & guarantees
description: State export credit agency: start-up loans, guarantees, export financing; often combined with VC rounds.

name: EIC Accelerator
deadline: Short proposals rolling; full-proposal cut-offs 2026: 7 Jan, 4 Mar, 6 May, 8 Jul, 2 Sep, 4 Nov
description: Lump-sum grant up to €2.5M (TRL 6–8 activities) + optional equity €1–10M via EIC Fund. Highly competitive (~4–5%). Prior technical due diligence at full-proposal stage.

name: EIC Transition
description: Matures results from EIC Pathfinder/ERC PoC/Horizon projects from lab validation (TRL 3–4) to relevant environment (TRL 5–6) + business case.

name: EIC Pathfinder
description: Breakthrough science → technology; usually ≥3 partners from 3 countries (Open).

name: Women TechEU
description: €75k grant + mentoring for deep-tech startups founded/led by women.

name: Sustainable Blue Economy Partnership – 4th Joint Transnational Call
deadline: Pre-proposals 16 Nov 2026 15:00 CET; full proposals ~14 Jun 2027
description: Transnational R&I consortia (national funders incl. Finland typically participate). Companies can join with research partners.

name: SBEP Regional Portfolio call – North Sea, Baltic & Mediterranean wave
description: Regional portfolio projects for sea-basin blue economy priorities incl. Baltic.

name: Horizon Europe Mission 'Restore our Ocean and Waters' – 2027 calls
description: Topics incl. riparian & coastal resilience (~€35.7M) and large-scale blue forest restoration (~€15.9M). Baltic & North Sea Lighthouse focuses on carbon-neutral & circular blue economy.

name: EMFAF directly-managed calls (BlueInvest / blue economy innovation)
deadline: Watch 2026/27 calls (last flagship call closed Feb 2025)
description: EU grants for blue economy SMEs to bring innovations to market; historically paired with BlueInvest investor-readiness.

name: BlueInvest Platform (investor readiness & Investor Days)
description: Free investor-readiness coaching, pitching at BlueInvest Days, visibility to 400+ blue investors. Great 'next step' for IRL 4–6 startups.

name: LIFE Programme
description: Environment, nature & climate demonstration projects close to market.

name: Interreg Baltic Sea Region
description: Transnational cooperation projects; startups join via public/research partners as pilot sites/solution providers.

name: Interreg Central Baltic (FI–SE–EE–LV–Åland)
description: Cross-border projects incl. blue growth & business cooperation in the central Baltic.

name: EU Innovation Fund (incl. small-scale & maritime decarbonisation)
description: First-of-a-kind commercial-scale low-carbon deployments (capex-heavy).

name: Horizon Europe – Zero-Emission Waterborne Transport (Cluster 5)
description: Ship decarbonisation, alternative fuels, port electrification demonstrations — join consortia with shipyards/operators.

name: Nordic Innovation – Nordic blue economy programmes (incl. NOCA)
description: Co-funds NOCA (A'Pelago) cross-border growth sprints; Nordic market access.

name: NEFCO – Baltic Sea / Nordic green financing
description: Green loans & funds for scaling Nordic environmental tech; Baltic Sea Action Plan related funding.

name: Innovation Norway – startup & innovation grants
description: Norwegian national innovation funding — relevant for expansion via a Norwegian entity.

name: Vinnova – innovation funding
description: Swedish innovation agency; many maritime/ocean calls.

name: The Earthshot Prize – Revive Our Oceans
deadline: Annual nomination cycle (nomination by official nominators)
description: £1M prize per category + global visibility & scaling support.

name: UNDP Ocean Innovation Challenge
description: Grants + technical support for ocean innovations, often in developing coastal countries.

name: Ocean Exchange – Neptune Award
description: $100k awards for solutions with ocean/economic impact.

name: EEN Finland – Blue Economy Pitch Challenge
description: Finnish SMEs pitch blue-economy solutions for a €25k EU prize.

name: A'Pelago 2027 programmes (Northern Blue · NOCA · Helsinki Blue Economy Studio · Lab2Impact)
deadline: NOCA & Helsinki Studio applications open (Oct 2026); Northern Blue & Lab2Impact TBA
description: Lab2Impact = research/idea; Helsinki Studio = Helsinki startups/growth; NOCA = 1-week Nordic market sprint for startups/SMEs; Northern Blue = 5-month international scaleup programme.
